adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, `comments` is set via `document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` and then unconditionally used as `comments.appendChild(iframe);`. If the host page does not contain an element with id `discourse-comments` (or the script executes before that element exists), `comments` will be `null` and calling `appendChild` will throw a `TypeError`, preventing the embed from rendering.
